name: Captions
shortDescription: AI video editor and caption tool. The paid Max plan is listed at $24.99/month.
longDescription: Captions is an AI video editor that adds captions and can edit uploaded footage. On October 16, 2026 its pricing page said a free version includes basic tools such as trimming, transitions, and some media library assets. The Max plan was listed at $24.99 per month. We did not create an account.
freeTierNotes: Trimming, transitions, and some media library assets.

Editing footage into a shorter captioned clip
